root_cause_criterion.criterion: Immediately after `endp -= kIp4AddressSize;`, `Address::FromString()` must establish `dst <= endp` before allowing the compaction-store loop at line 333 to execute.
root_cause_criterion.description: On the crashing input, reserving the embedded-IPv4 tail moves `endp` back to byte 11 while `dst` already names byte 13. The fixed image adds `VerifyOrExit(dst <= endp, error = OT_ERROR_PARSE);` at this site, so the malformed original PoC is rejected before the compaction-store loop executes, while the one-group-shorter witness reaches the same loop with `dst == endp`.

nodes.description: At the first out-of-bounds compaction-store iteration, `endp` already points one byte before `mFields.m8`, so the next `*endp-- = *dst--;` write underflows the 16-byte destination object.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable original trace records `compact_underflow_write.endp_before_store < compact_underflow_write.base_ptr`.

nodes.description: When the compaction loop is first entered, it still uses the tail limit created by `endp -= kIp4AddressSize;` at the root-cause site.
At compaction entry, `colonp` still lies one byte before `mFields.m8`, so the loop bound extends past the start of the destination object.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable original and genuine witness traces record `compact_entry.colonp_before_compact < compact_entry.base_ptr`.

edges.relation: The `endp` value created by the embedded-IPv4 tail reservation reaches the first compaction-loop iteration unchanged, so the loop runs with the truncated tail limit established at the root-cause site.
edges.evidence: Both traces record `post_ipv4_guard.endp_after_ipv4_reserve == compact_entry.endp_before_compact` when compaction executes.

edges.relation: The pre-buffer `colonp` bound is carried unchanged from compaction entry to the first underflowing store, so the backward copy continues until the destination pointer moves before `mFields.m8`.
